question: Does Georgia acceptance turn the contract story into profitable, funded Build revenue before dilution absorbs the upside?
takeaway: Q3 Access gross margin was only 4.58%; positive operating income included $10.48M digital-asset gains. The next operating proof is customer acceptance and service entry. A new December 17 equity-plan vote adds a nearer capital-allocation checkpoint.
valuation_note: November 26 sheet supersedes the prior open question on amended Georgia contract size: October 5 issuer release estimates $364.6M over five years. Revenue cadence, numerical gross margin and common cash economics remain unresolved. Observed November 25 close is $6.63 (provider snapshot, not executable); the new sheet quantifies cash-flow hurdles using the historical 21.37M common-plus-prefunded floor, not a current fully diluted valuation or stock target.

cases.name: Bull
cases.thesis: Georgia acceptance leads to actual service delivery and evidence of attractive incremental Build economics.
cases.requires: Dated acceptance and service commencement; billing/recognized-revenue evidence; updated contract term economics; a financing bridge that meets deployment and seller obligations.
cases.invalidated_by: Acceptance fails, service economics disappoint, or funding/issuance required to deliver consumes expected equity upside.

cases.name: Base
cases.thesis: Access continues while Build remains a deployment and acceptance story; contract headlines alone do not resolve valuation.
cases.requires: Customer prepayments remain supportable and delivery progresses within the revised Q4 2026/Q1 2027 roadmap.
cases.invalidated_by: Verified Build launch changes the business mix, or delivery/customer/funding problems undermine the roadmap.

cases.name: Bear
cases.thesis: Delayed service, weak realized margins or capital dilution reduce the equity value of the signed portfolio.
cases.requires: Evidence such as failed acceptance, customer changes, adverse funding terms, unexpected share issuance or additional roadmap revision.
cases.invalidated_by: Timely accepted service with demonstrated cash economics and a fully reconciled funding plan.

checkpoints.label: Annual meeting / equity plan vote
checkpoints.watch: Proposal 3 outcome; distinguish reserve authorization from grants and issued shares.
checkpoints.positive: Transparent award terms and capital allocation; reconcile economic share exposure after any grant.
checkpoints.negative: Material incremental awards or unfavorable terms that weaken per-share economics; approval alone is not completed dilution.

checkpoints.label: Georgia acceptance → service → revenue
checkpoints.watch: Dated customer acceptance, commencement and revenue cadence/margin under the amended five-year term; issuer estimates $364.6M lifetime revenue, not a verified even quarterly schedule.
checkpoints.positive: Accepted service plus credible revenue/margin evidence, separately dated.
checkpoints.negative: Failed acceptance or an explicit later revision. No news by the 90-day horizon is not automatically a missed March 31 roadmap.

checkpoints.label: Recurring economics and customer obligations
checkpoints.watch: Build versus Access revenue; gross margin; token-gain adjustments; cash, prepayments, capex and lease obligations.
checkpoints.positive: Incremental Build gross profit and a reconciled funding bridge.
checkpoints.negative: GAAP profits still dominated by token gains or customer/prepayment deterioration.

checkpoints.label: Per-share and funding reconciliation
checkpoints.watch: ATM sales, prefunded exercises, actual equity awards and refinancing terms. Seller balance can accelerate on cluster refinancing.
checkpoints.positive: Same-date instrument reconciliation and sufficient usable funding after creditor repayment.
checkpoints.negative: Headline cash or market cap improves only because the presentation omits obligations or economic shares.

gaps: No verified current executable quote, spread, borrow availability or full economic share count; a separately dated November 25 provider closing-price snapshot is now available.
No documented customer acceptance or later Build revenue commencement in the reviewed operating disclosures.
No complete dated funding bridge; customer-funded cash cannot be assumed distributable.

No disclosed numerical Build gross margin or amended Georgia billing cadence. October 5 issuer lifetime estimate is now established at $364.6M over five years; see the November 26 decision sheet, superseding this portion of the November 25 brief.
Customer A/B identities and contract termination protections are not established.
No confirmed next earnings date; the 90-day horizon ends February 23, before the revised Q1 roadmap ends.

metrics.label: Q3 Access gross margin
metrics.basis: Calculated: ($7,243,043 revenue − $6,911,526 cost) / revenue; quarter ended Sep 30.

metrics.label: Q3 profit quality
metrics.basis: Reported digital-asset gains exceed $6.826M GAAP operating income; EBITDA is non-GAAP.

metrics.label: Cash versus service obligations
metrics.basis: Separate Sep 30 reported balances; neither net cash nor a simple deficit calculation.

metrics.label: Partial economic shares
metrics.basis: Calculated common 13,634,097 + prefunded 7,736,379; historical and excludes other instruments.

metrics.label: December 17 vote
metrics.basis: Proposed capacity, not issued shares; evergreen starts Jan 2028.
